values.value: Copies your Memberships Essentials membership products (those with a tier) as BarnCRM membership levels, then your Essentials memberships as BarnCRM memberships at those levels, keeping their account, primary contact and dates. Dues are not copied: enter them on each level. Memberships Essentials itself is never changed.
